title: Authoritative corrected Man Grid language/phonetics reconstruction plan
correction: The earlier ChatGPT implementation used the wrong computational object: first the A1-D4 / 16-state / 256-gate proxy, and later an incorrect traced/manual Man Grid representation. Those were ChatGPT implementation errors. Earlier results remain historical research records but are not valid evidence for the correct Man Grid. All corrected tests use the same exact computational data model as the live website Man Grid engine.

exact_grid.mirror: LEFT <-> RIGHT with the same layer, row and column, above and below the transformative circle
exact_grid.hypothesis: The mirrored Man Grid may provide a mechanism by which a parent phonetic/language state can produce two sibling language states. This is a hypothesis to test, not an assumed property.

required_parity: same two-component PCA seeds, signs and percentile bounds
same L/R mirror addressing on every rectangular layer

execution_contract.partitioning: each shard owns a deterministic disjoint partition of the assigned evidence; 20 repetitions of the full test do not count as shards
execution_contract.timeouts: do not impose arbitrary short execution timeouts
execution_contract.dependency_rule: dependent tests consume the actual output of preceding corrected tests
execution_contract.failed_shards: diagnose and rerun failed shard(s); never silently drop them
required_reporting: effect size or equivalent quantitative measure
execution_contract.sources: Use pinned PHOIBLE, WikiPron, Wiktionary/Wiktextract and established repository datasets where appropriate, preserving pinned source versions.
execution_contract.invalid-result-boundary: Do not import mappings, reconstructions or transformation rules learned from the invalid 16-state or traced-grid experiments.

tests.name: Original phonetic reconstruction
tests.purpose: Analyse usable phonetic evidence across available languages and families through the exact 1074-cell mirrored Man Grid. Reconstruct a candidate ancestral phoneme inventory before lexical reconstruction and test shared-parent / two-sibling representation rather than assuming it.

tests.name: Man Grid phonetic locality / control
tests.purpose: Independently determine whether genuinely similar phonemes occupy structurally related exact Man Grid states more often than shuffled/random assignments.

tests.name: Parent to two sibling phonetic systems falsification test
tests.purpose: Use real within-family sibling branches where possible and compare them with unrelated or deterministically mismatched pairs. Test whether one shared parent predicts both real sibling branches better than controls; do not force a positive result.

tests.name: Original-language lexical reconstruction
tests.purpose: Scan full usable multilingual dictionary evidence, group comparable meanings, and reconstruct same-meaning ancestral forms using only the corrected Test 1 phonetics, exact Man Grid and independent family evidence.

tests.name: Full dictionary expansion and stability
tests.purpose: Expand toward approximately 12000 words or more if evidence supports more; never force exactly 12000. Each entry should retain gloss, reconstructed form and IPA, Man Grid phoneme/path representation, contributing languages/families, confidence, alternatives and historical/transformation evidence; run leave-family-out and shard-stability checks.

tests.name: Nearest current and historical language
tests.purpose: Relearn which attested languages are closest to the corrected reconstruction using the exact Man Grid representation; do not reuse the old ranking.

tests.name: Origin / family enrichment plus held-out-family stress test
tests.purpose: Test whether any family is genuinely unusually similar while excluding that family from evidence used to build the predictor, explicitly guarding against circularity and false origin claims.

tests.name: Reverse-family convergence
tests.purpose: Reverse-transform independent language families using the corrected representation and determine whether they reproducibly converge on the same ancestral attractor rather than arbitrary modern languages.

tests.name: Data-driven sibling-language anchor discovery
tests.purpose: Discover which extant or historical languages/groups best occupy the two sibling branches. Do not hard-code Occitan or Indonesian; independently rediscover or reject the earlier behaviour.

tests.name: Common-parent test of discovered sibling anchors
tests.purpose: Infer a parent using only the two discovered sibling branches, then test it against the independently reconstructed root, held-out languages and random-pair controls.

tests.name: Sibling-constrained candidate-language reconstruction
tests.purpose: Reconstruct a second complete candidate lexicon using discovered sibling information only as constrained additional evidence while retaining independent multilingual family evidence.

tests.name: Independent candidate validation
tests.purpose: Compare correct sibling anchors, no sibling anchors, and shuffled/wrong-meaning anchors against held-out languages, families and meanings to test genuine predictive value.

tests.name: Historical language drift through the correct Man Grid
tests.purpose: Learn documented ancestor-to-descendant phonetic/language changes using held-out historical examples with shuffled-target and wrong-meaning controls; do not import old-grid transformation rules.

tests.name: All-language transformation-rule discovery
tests.purpose: Learn statistically supported substitutions, insertions, deletions, positional/context-conditioned changes, Man Grid movements, sibling-branch changes, mirror relationships and transformative-circle behaviour only where supported.

tests.name: Rule-augmented original-language reconstruction
tests.purpose: Feed only cross-validated historically supported rules back into the corrected reconstruction and compare rule-augmented, unaugmented and shuffled-rule systems on held-out prediction.

tests.name: Final phonetics / language / dictionary consistency pass
tests.purpose: Freeze the corrected original phoneme inventory, reconstructed language, transformation rules, 12000+ word dictionary if supported, pronunciation representation/audio support, confidence/evidence tables and explicit evidence boundaries.

website_contract.label_invalid_old_results: historical records from ChatGPT implementation error; not evidence for the correct Man Grid
required_explanation: what the exact Man Grid is
